checkRuns.command: sed -i "s#import { enhance } from '\$app/forms';#import { enhance, type SubmitFunction } from '\$app/forms';#; /import type { SubmitFunction } from '@sveltejs\/kit';/d" src/routes/contact/+page.svelte && head -6 src/routes/contact/+page.svelte && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -8

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun server.js"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun add -d happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:4701/
ps aux | grep -c "[s]erver.js"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun add -d happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1

printf -- '--- title: Aaa Test author: Tester year: 1900 rating: 5 tags: [zzz] --- Hello **world**. ' > content/books/aaa-test.md bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/bs.log 2>&1 & sleep 1.5 curl -s http://localhost:4702/books/aaa-test | grep -o '.*\|world'; curl -s http://localhost:4702/ | grep -o '
    .*
'; curl -s http://localhost:4702/books | grep -o '>zzz<' ps aux | grep "[b]un server.js" | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill; rm content/books/aaa-test.md; sleep 1 bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/bs.log 2>&1 & sleep 1.5 for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /about /contact /x /books/aaa-test; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4701$p)"; done ps aux | grep "[b]un server.js" | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; ps aux | grep -c "[b]un server.js"; git status --short content
